cards.condition: Lateral chest radiograph where a soft-tissue finding's side is being inferred.
cards.procedure: Avoid declaring a side from the anterior soft-tissue shadow alone without confirming the projection convention or other lateralizing evidence.

grounding.reason: Wrong run declared left from anterior shadow alone; supports avoiding unconfirmed side.

transfer.reason: Clear caution against side inference without convention; transferable and respects uncertainty.

cards.condition: Frontal radiograph where a finding is described as on the image side.
cards.procedure: Avoid equating image-right with patient-left without verifying the display convention; recheck orientation before committing to a side.

grounding.reason: Wrong run equated image-right with patient-left; supports verifying display convention.

transfer.reason: Explicitly warns against image-side/patient-side confusion; cleanly transferable.

cards.condition: Frontal chest radiograph with a device whose side must be assigned
cards.procedure: Ground the device to original-image coordinates, then map image side to patient side using standard frontal orientation before choosing the option.

grounding.reason: Successful run grounds device to original coordinates then maps image side to patient side.

transfer.reason: Clear frontal device laterality procedure; orientation mapping explicit and actionable.

cards.condition: Device localization relies on an overlay or grounded box that appears central or mediastinal
cards.procedure: Avoid assigning laterality from the overlay position alone; recheck the device against original-image coordinates and patient-side orientation.

grounding.reason: Wrong run relied on central overlay box; rechecking original coordinates is supported.

transfer.reason: Scoped caution against overlay-only laterality; recheck original coordinates, actionable.

cards.condition: Lateral view shows effusion signs but laterality is inferred from a single model's spine/diaphragm impression
cards.procedure: Avoid committing to a side from one model's lateral-view impression; require corroborating fluid-level or sulcus evidence before choosing.

grounding.reason: Wrong run trusted single model spine/diaphragm impression; corroboration warranted.

transfer.reason: Clear limit on single-model lateral inference; requires corroborating evidence.

cards.condition: Lateral view shows curvature but the side is chosen only because it is one of the offered options
cards.procedure: Avoid selecting a side merely because curvature is present; require explicit convexity direction evidence before assigning laterality.

grounding.reason: Wrong run picked side without convexity evidence; requiring explicit direction is supported.

transfer.reason: Scoped guard against option-driven side choice; requires convexity evidence.

cards.condition: Frontal radiograph where a device side is being inferred from screen position
cards.procedure: Avoid assigning patient side from screen-right without applying the frontal mirror convention; that inverts laterality.

grounding.reason: Wrong run inverted side from screen-right; correct run applied mirror convention, matching procedure.

transfer.reason: Scoped to frontal laterality; actionable mirror-convention rule, no donor specifics.

cards.condition: Lateral view where models disagree on basal opacity side
cards.procedure: Avoid resolving side by majority vote or tie-breaking with more model opinions; vote counts do not establish laterality.

grounding.reason: Wrong run resolved side by model vote/tie-break; correct run used expert, supporting no-vote rule.

transfer.reason: Clear lateral laterality limit; warns against vote-counting, transferable.

cards.condition: Lateral view with a side marker and a catheter
cards.procedure: Avoid inferring catheter side from a single marker or trajectory alone; a lone marker can mislead without tracing the device.

grounding.reason: Wrong run relied on lone L marker/trajectory; correct run traced device, supporting rule.

transfer.reason: Scoped lateral device laterality; actionable, though marker/trajectory nuance is broad.

cards.condition: Lateral chest radiograph with a radiopaque finding in the anterior soft tissue and laterality options.
cards.procedure: Zoom the anterior soft tissue and use the stated projection convention to assign the finding to the correct side before choosing.

grounding.reason: Successful run used zoom plus projection convention to assign right side; trace supports procedure.

transfer.reason: Scoped to lateral view, anterior soft tissue, laterality; actionable with projection convention.

cards.condition: Frontal radiograph with a radiopaque abdominal finding and left/right options.
cards.procedure: Localize the finding relative to the midline and confirm patient-side orientation before selecting the side.

grounding.reason: Successful run localized relative to midline; wrong run mislabeled image-right as left.

transfer.reason: Frontal abdominal finding laterality; actionable, requires orientation confirmation.

cards.condition: Frontal radiograph with a small pleural effusion and left/right options.
cards.procedure: Compare both costophrenic angles and use grounded localization of the effusion to the correct angle before choosing.

grounding.reason: Successful run used grounded right-angle localization; wrong run cited left angle.

transfer.reason: Scoped to frontal pleural effusion laterality; actionable via costophrenic angle comparison.

cards.condition: Lateral view with a pleural finding whose side is uncertain
cards.procedure: Cross-check the side with an independent image-reading model and inspect posterior costophrenic angles before committing to a side.

grounding.reason: Successful run used independent model plus posterior CP angle inspection to fix side.

transfer.reason: Scoped to lateral pleural laterality; procedure actionable though model cross-check is vague.

cards.condition: Lateral view where a model asserts a side without localizing evidence
cards.procedure: Avoid accepting a stated side from a single model or from a benchmark-specific convention; require visual localization first.

grounding.reason: Wrong run accepted a model's side without localization; supports avoiding that.

transfer.reason: Clear contraindication; requires visual localization, avoids single-model side claims.

cards.condition: Lateral view with a rib finding and conflicting model side outputs
cards.procedure: Zoom into the posterior rib region and reconcile the side against an independent model before selecting the side.

grounding.reason: Successful run zoomed posterior ribs and reconciled conflicting model sides.

transfer.reason: Scoped to lateral rib laterality; zoom and reconcile steps are actionable.

cards.condition: Lateral view where one model gives a confident side but another reports no finding
cards.procedure: Avoid defaulting to the confident single model; treat the disagreement as unresolved until direct visual inspection confirms the side.

grounding.reason: Wrong run defaulted to confident model despite other reporting none; supports caution.

transfer.reason: Clear disagreement rule; defers to direct visual inspection before committing.

cards.condition: Lateral view with a diaphragm elevation side question
cards.procedure: Confirm the elevated hemidiaphragm with two independent readers and localize the higher contour before choosing the side.

grounding.reason: Successful run confirmed left elevation via two independent readers.

transfer.reason: Scoped to lateral diaphragm; two-reader confirmation and localization are actionable.

cards.condition: Lateral view where normal anatomic height asymmetry is invoked to infer the abnormal side
cards.procedure: Avoid concluding the side from typical right-higher-than-left anatomy alone; verify actual elevation on the image.

grounding.reason: Wrong run inferred side from typical right-higher anatomy; supports avoiding that.

transfer.reason: Clear contraindication against inferring side from normal height asymmetry alone.
